name: us2-adopt-fault-401
description: 003 US2 (T092, AS-6): an authentication failure is injected during discovery. An unreliable read means the candidate corpus is incomplete, and an incomplete corpus turns an ambiguity that must be refused into a binding that would be applied — so the WHOLE run aborts BEFORE any write, with zero property PUTs in the call log and exit 3 (FR-008, Constitution III).
